purpose: Marginal-role inventory; not extra evidence or source replay.
source_overlap: Summaries within each named source share its cohort. The three named study families are distinct; participant overlap is not established or used as a precision claim. Multiple unit forms are not independent evidence.
context_reason: Jansen excludes diabetes and anemia and uses plasma/IFCC; Bao excludes known diabetes and reports quartiles with unknown quantile algorithm. Their margins do not identify target tails or dependence. MIND age is not transported because task age range differs. NGSP is contextual only.
uncertainty: No inverse-variance combination, SD-to-SE conversion, artificial confidence interval or claimed clinical target fit.
